sponsored.t: Removes residency requirements for Washington county deputy county attorneys
sponsored.sum: Removes residency requirements for Washington county deputy county attorneys, provided that they live in Washington county or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Enacts Joycelynn's Law
sponsored.sum: Establishes the offenses of aggravated endangering the welfare of a child and aggravated endangering the welfare of a child resulting in death.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of renewable energy siting and electric transmission function in line with the state's commitment to environmental conservation
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of renewable energy siting and electric transmission function in line with the state's commitment to environmental conservation including but not limited to the state's thirty by thirty conservation goal, open space conservation plan, and forest preserves.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Warren to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Bradley Murphy, a patrol officer employed by such county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Warren to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Bradley Murphy, a patrol officer employed by such county.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Officer Stephen L. Raymond
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system, consisting of the bridge located on Diamond Point road at exit twenty-three of interstate eighty-seven in the town of Lake George, county of Warren, to Officer Stephen L. Raymond.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of revenues from hotel or motel taxes in the county of Essex
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of revenues from hotel or motel taxes in the county of Essex for the use of tourism promotion and development and economic development.

sponsored.t: Transfers certain state property located in the town of Queensbury to the county of Warren
sponsored.sum: Transfers certain state property owned by the New York state division of military and naval affairs located in the town of Queensbury to the county of Warren provided certain requirements are met.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an expedited application review process for certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with Double H Ranch
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an expedited application review process for certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with Double H Ranch; provides such application fee shall be waived.

sponsored.t: Waives metered parking fees for certain vehicles displaying a handicapped permit or with handicapped plates
sponsored.sum: Waives metered parking fees for certain vehicles displaying a handicapped permit or with handicapped plates.

sponsored.t: Establishes a municipal solar planning grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a municipal solar planning grant program for municipalities to receive grants for plans to develop solar energy systems on agricultural land and commercially-zoned properties in such municipalities; creates a database to track such solar energy system distribution.

sponsored.t: Provides for the recall power of the electors to remove an elective officer
sponsored.sum: Provides for the recall power of the electors to remove an elective officer.

sponsored.t: Relates to the taxation of property owned by a cooperative corporation
sponsored.sum: Relates to the taxation of property owned by a cooperative corporation in the towns of Bolton, Horicon, Thurman, Queensbury, Lake George, and Warrensburg.

sponsored.t: Provides for the viewing of footage captured by an interior school bus camera in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Provides for the viewing of photo or video footage captured by a camera installed inside a school bus, by a parent or guardian of a pupil, when such parent, guardian or pupil reports any incident of physical harm, harassment, intimidation or bullying occurring against the pupil while such pupil travelled on such school bus.

sponsored.t: Increases the designation of certain offenses relating to unlawfully fleeing a police officer and makes such offenses eligible for bail
sponsored.sum: Increases the designation of certain offenses relating to unlawfully fleeing a police officer and makes such offenses eligible for bail.

sponsored.t: Repeals sections of law relating to private roads
sponsored.sum: Relates to private roads; repeals various provisions relating to the application for the creation of a private road.

sponsored.t: Requires nonresident visitor sex offenders and registered sex offenders register when temporarily residing within the state
sponsored.sum: Requires nonresident visitor sex offenders and registered sex offenders register when temporarily residing within the state; requires short-term rental hosts and short-term rental hosting platforms inform nearby property owners when nonresident visitor sex offenders and registered sex offenders are staying in the unit.

sponsored.t: Adds Falls Brook, Jones Brook, Kelso Brook, Minerva Stream, and Trout Brook to the definition of inland waterways for the purposes of waterfront revitalization
sponsored.sum: Adds Falls Brook, Jones Brook, Kelso Brook, Minerva Stream, and Trout Brook to the definition of inland waterways for the purposes of waterfront revitalization.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities to contract for services through contracts let by any other governmental entity
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities to contract for services through contracts let by any other governmental entity.

sponsored.t: Relates to segregated confinement; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to segregated confinement; provides that certain incarcerated individuals shall not be placed in a residential rehabilitation unit; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain electronic court appearances
sponsored.sum: Authorizes electronic court appearances for criminal matters, excluding jury trials, in all counties in the state; authorizes electronic appearances for criminal matters where the court determines a personal appearance would be impractical, unsafe or excessively burdensome; authorizes sentencing to a period of incarceration to be conducted via electronic appearance for defendants who are already incarcerated.

sponsored.t: Provides for the establishment of a separate office of family court judge for the county of Essex
sponsored.sum: Provides for the establishment of a separate office of family court judge for the county of Essex.

sponsored.t: Creates a tax credit for small businesses that sell a certain percentage of products produced in New York state
sponsored.sum: Creates a tax credit for small businesses that sell a certain percentage of products produced in New York state; provides such small businesses include independently or privately-owned cafes, restaurants, eateries, bars, pubs, breweries, distilleries, orchards, food trucks, retail stores, farm stands, hotels, or motels.

sponsored.t: Requires the state pay taxes on the assessed value of properties of closed state prisons
sponsored.sum: Requires the state pay taxes on the assessed value of properties of closed state prisons until such prison is reopened, used by another state agency, or is conveyed to a non-governmental entity.

sponsored.t: Relates to safe staffing levels at nursing homes
sponsored.sum: Relates to safe staffing levels at nursing homes; requires the department of health to give significant weight to labor supply shortages in particular regions during any declared statewide disaster emergency.

sponsored.t: Relates to special districts for ambulance services
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of special districts for general ambulance services in any county, city, town or village located within the Adirondack park.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the authorized reimbursement rate paid to governmental entities for enforcement of navigation laws
sponsored.sum: Restores the authorized reimbursement rate paid to governmental entities for enforcement of navigation laws to 75% of authorized expenditures.

sponsored.t: Requires the state to pay real property taxes on the assessed value of the Moriah shock incarceration correctional facility
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to pay all real property taxes on the assessed value of the Moriah shock incarceration correctional facility.

sponsored.t: Requires public vessels which carry passengers to be covered by insurance or a surety bond covering injury or death to the passengers
sponsored.sum: Requires public vessels which carry passengers to be covered by insurance or a surety bond covering injury or death to the passengers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the calculation of selected operating aid per pupil for the Boquet Valley central school district
sponsored.sum: Relates to the calculation of selected operating aid per pupil for the Boquet Valley central school district; provides the date of reorganization, July 1, 2019, shall be used when calculating.

sponsored.t: Relates to the crime of endangering the welfare of a child
sponsored.sum: Creates a new class D violent felony offense of endangering the welfare of a child in the first degree; converts the current offense of endangering the welfare of a child to a second degree crime.

sponsored.t: Establishes that instruction in financial literacy be provided to pupils in grades nine, ten, eleven or twelve
sponsored.sum: Requires that instruction in financial literacy be provided to pupils in grades nine through twelve; establishes what should be included in such curriculum including the basics of financial planning, budgeting, borrowing, interest rates, and personal insurance policies.

sponsored.t: Relates to the computation of building aid for the Boquet Valley Central School District
sponsored.sum: Relates to the computation of building aid for the construction, reconstruction or modernizing of no more than one project by the Boquet Valley Central school district.

sponsored.t: Requiring the county seat in Warren county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
sponsored.sum: Requires the county seat in Warren county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.

sponsored.t: Exempts veterans and those on active duty from paying certain fees for travel
sponsored.sum: Exempts veterans and those on active duty from paying certain fees for travel on the New York world war veterans memorial highway in Essex county or Prospect mountain veteran's memorial highway in Warren county.

sponsored.t: Grants Barbara Juh Tier 5 status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive Tier 5 status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Barbara Juh.

sponsored.t: Includes Hague Brook in the list of inland waterways eligible for the local waterfront revitalization program
sponsored.sum: Includes Hague Brook in the list of inland waterways eligible for the local waterfront revitalization program.

sponsored.t: Establishes a distinctive plate for the Adirondack park
sponsored.sum: Establishes a distinctive plate for the Adirondack park.

sponsored.t: Waives the residency requirement for certain county attorney positions within Warren county
sponsored.sum: Waives the residency requirement for certain county attorney positions within Warren county including assistant district attorney, assistant public defender and assistant county attorney.

sponsored.t: Relates to expenditures for Warren county community colleges; extends the effectiveness of provisions relating to an additional Warren county mortgage recording tax
sponsored.sum: Relates to Warren county no longer providing community colleges funding with excess funds from the collection of mortgage recording taxes as such money is allocated to the CDTA; extends the effectiveness of provisions relating to an additional Warren county mortgage recording tax to December 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Essex to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Essex to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30th, 2027.
